label: Manager
description: A department head: everything an employee holds, plus the department subtree - the team's records, requests to decide, goals, 1:1s, reviews and roster. Manages the boards filed under their department (the department's `board-share` rules), and creates boards there.

levels.why: Create a board. It must be filed under a department the manager manages (services/boardShares.ts assertMayFileUnder), and managing it - and every board filed under their department or one below it - comes from `board-share` rules written for that department's managers, not from a role rule.
roster the team (create gate pins the owner to the dept scope below)

Put the team on a schedule. The CATALOG stays HR's (a manager picks from the patterns that exist, and does not invent one), which is the same split as shifts: `shifts.**` is HR's below and a manager only rosters them.

Base directory record of each dept member (2-token item) - NOT their sub-resources. `employees.my-dept` matches `employees.<member>` but not `employees.<member>.bank-account`, so a manager sees the team roster without their PII (PII stays super-only by default). Own PII still via OWN_PII.
The team's probation end dates: the manager is who the nightly reminder asks to confirm or extend.
The team's employee numbers: a redacted field the directory read does not reach, and the one HR identifier a manager quotes about their own people.
Presence of each dept member - the same reading of leave + attendance the manager already holds through `attendance.my-dept.**`, surfaced as the profile header's pill.
dept's leave-requests (to review/approve) - no PII sub-resources

The manager's half of the goal-setting handshake: agree the goal a report submitted, or send it back with the reason (services/goals.ts#approveGoal / #requestGoalChanges). `my-dept` like every other decision verb here - `*` would let a manager agree any department's goals. A goal the manager SETS for a report lands AGREED at creation, so these are only ever the report-proposed path.

excluded.why: A manager decides for their own department only; `*` would let them decide any department's (cross-department BOLA).
Re-valuing a report's day is a pay decision the seeded default leaves with HR; an org that wants managers doing it grants write in the ACL.
The team's bank, identity, personal-info and tax sub-resources stay with HR and payroll.

excluded.pattern: boards.** | sprints.** write, boards.** | sprints.** verbs (any board)
excluded.why: A manager manages the boards filed under their department and the departments below it, through `board-share` rules services/boardShares.ts keeps in step with each department's managers - never every board in the org. Boards with no department are managed by their creator, their sharing list, super admin and the project manager.
